opening.argument: The presentation asks viewers to pay a $99 partnership fee and purchase cryptocurrency-mining pools priced from $500 to $3,500, while describing recurring wallet proceeds and daily withdrawals. It ties purchased shares to daily Bitcoin percentages, stating, "For every share that you purchase, you receive a daily percentage from all the Bitcoins got in 1 pool per day." It also presents Clubcoin bonuses, forecast appreciation, account interest, and compensation from recruited partners and binary teams, including a bonus for "building 2 teams." Viewers are invited to make contact through Skype. The material does not establish whether mining, payouts, withdrawals, token value, or participant losses actually occurred.
